level.title: Monday Morning
level.tagline: Everyone who waited all weekend arrives at once.
briefing: Simulation two. The rota you inherit was written by someone who has never worked a Monday.
Monday is the busiest day of the week. Everyone who got sick over the weekend and waited arrives between nine and noon, and they keep coming until evening.
You have the same number of doctor-hours as the last director. Move them to where the patients are.

pass: Same doctor-hours, different outcome. Staffing to the arrival curve costs nothing.
Notice what happened in the hours you left thin: the waiting line did not just grow, it kept growing after the rush ended.
fail: The doctors were there. They were there at the wrong time.
Look at when patients arrived and when doctors were on shift. Line those up and run it again.

goals.label: Fewer than 4% leave without being seen
ESI 1–2 seen within 20 minutes on average
